evidence_classes.observed: Historical dataset and public source statements
evidence_classes.user_confirmed: Eight named challenges apply to 2026; reply 4 interpreted as four teammates
evidence_classes.judgment: Ratings, weights, differentiation hypotheses and recommended scope
evidence_classes.proposed: All new features, benchmark workloads, tests and build milestones
evidence_classes.unresolved: Skills, hardware, remaining time, current event-specific rules and secondary eligibility

team_assumptions.size_basis: User answered 4 to the team question; treated as team size.
team_assumptions.skills: Unspecified; baseline assumes web/API skills and at least one person comfortable with SQL.
team_assumptions.hardware: No specialized hardware assumed; ordinary laptops and a microphone for the voice alternative.
team_assumptions.time: Full 36-hour window is a planning baseline, not a claim about remaining hours. Shorter-time plans are conditional.
team_assumptions.hacking_window: Friday 25 September 2026 23:00 to Sunday 27 September 2026 11:00 America/New_York. Exact submission cutoff remains unverified.

eligibility_prerequisite: Confirm participant eligibility and attendance, actual accepted sponsor product use, event build/reuse rules and current submission/opt-in. Every ranking is conditional until these pass; no score overrides an eligibility failure. Holds are additional resource/use-case gates.
secondary_categories: Technical compatibility is evaluated. No second category is represented as eligible because maximum entries, exclusivity and simultaneous awards remain unverified.
weight_reason: Challenge fit and useful integration receive 40% together because the objective is a coherent sponsor-dependent project. Feasibility receives 20%; distinction and demo receive 15% each; dependency safety 10%. These are planning judgments, not MLH weights or findings from winners.

scale.challenge_fit: 1 tangential; 3 meets broad usage language; 5 direct match to the brief and its stated emphasis.
scale.useful_integration: 1 decorative; 3 useful supporting role; 5 removing the sponsor breaks a core capability.
scale.feasibility: 1 implausible without missing expertise; 3 requires material scope cuts; 5 bounded with familiar tools and few moving parts.
scale.differentiation: 1 commodity use case; 3 focused testable distinction; 5 unusually strong demonstrated distinction would be needed. No concept is asserted globally novel.
scale.demonstrability: 1 result hard to inspect; 3 meaningful but explanation-dependent; 5 clear user action and visible verified consequence.
scale.dependency_safety: 1 unresolved specialist/access blockers; 3 manageable external risks; 5 few dependencies and practical fallback.

formula: Total = sum(weight × rating / 5). The result is a decision score out of 100, not a win probability, observed outcome or official judging score.

ranking.name: ReplayBench
ranking.rationale: The sponsor performs the central time-series work; correctness and measured latency are visible. SQL skill and account access remain assumptions.

ranking.name: Handoff Lab
ranking.rationale: Voice is intrinsic and the repair loop is demonstrable. Existing roleplay products and live audio risk limit differentiation and safety scores.

ranking.name: LineCheck
ranking.rationale: Useful document extraction supports deterministic reconciliation. Mature competitors constrain differentiation; evidence locations need validation.

ranking.name: PantryRelay
ranking.rationale: Atlas owns real reservation state; a race/duplicate scan demo is clear. Domain differentiation and actual operator validation are limited.

ranking.name: LostLink
ranking.rationale: Multimodal retrieval is central. A fair image set and no-match calibration take time; NotLost already covers the broad use case.

ranking.name: BranchBridge
ranking.rationale: Responsive character voices support a coherent game; authored branching contains scope. Synchronization and autonomous-audio interpretation need checking.

ranking.name: Counterexample Arcade
ranking.rationale: The core is easy to verify with few dependencies, but cloud hosting has a supporting role and is a weaker sponsor centerpiece.

ranking.name: EvidenceDelta
ranking.rationale: Version-specific retrieval and inference fit the sponsor, but account, indexing and evidence alignment create several coupled dependencies.

ranking.name: Contract Canary
ranking.rationale: A hosted replay service is useful and demonstrable; the sponsor role is less distinctive than the contract diagnosis itself.

ranking.name: StormTable
ranking.rationale: Only a substantive event-history/replay redesign justifies time-series tooling; a tiny scripted map does not.

ranking.name: FormTrail
ranking.rationale: Source-grounded simplification can help, but deterministic completeness remains the core. Do not let AI invent form requirements.

ranking.name: WindowWise
ranking.rationale: Atlas can retain schedules and service records; the small feasibility engine alone gives the sponsor limited distinctive work.

ranking.name: ReceiptRelay
ranking.rationale: Unconfirmed cross-organization trust need, test-network acceptance and specialist skill. Do not select on score until those gates clear.

ranking.name: Pulse Path
ranking.rationale: Hardware is not confirmed, and sparse cue logs are weak justification for time-series machinery. A simulator would be a different scoped product.

fresh_concepts.name: ReplayBench
fresh_concepts.tagline: Prove whether delayed telemetry changes a dashboard correctly.
fresh_concepts.problem: A developer sees yesterday’s count change after buffered events arrive, or sees an apparently current chart omit late history. The task is to reproduce, explain and repair one bounded case.
fresh_concepts.integration: Use Tiger Data as the only database: relational device metadata, a time-partitioned event table and one continuous aggregate. Compare event time with arrival time; explicitly refresh affected historical buckets. No AI, blockchain or second database.
fresh_concepts.mvp: Three simulated devices, one integer-valued event schema, a 100,000-row seed stream, late arrivals, unchanged duplicates and a disconnected stream. Controls inject faults; a timeline shows the affected bucket, correction and independent count/sum result. Scale toward one million only after the core works.
fresh_concepts.demo: Show a stable total; inject late events; reveal a stale historical aggregate; refresh the complete affected bucket; show agreement with an independent reference calculation. Replay an unchanged duplicate and demonstrate no inflation. Then show measured raw-query versus aggregate-query timings.
fresh_concepts.validation: Twelve seeded scenarios covering timely, late, duplicate, missing and combined cases; exact integer count/sum agreement after completed refresh. Run at least thirty comparable queries per path on the same dataset, query semantics and service; report median/p95, environment, warm/cold status and refresh cost separately. These are future tests, not results.
fresh_concepts.difference: A guided fault-injection and repair exercise with an independently checked result, aimed at a developer’s first time-series prototype. Existing monitoring products already diagnose metrics and data quality; the proposed distinction is the compact reproducible teaching/test workflow, not a new database algorithm.
fresh_concepts.history_reason: Freetear and Pegasus made development friction concrete; Farsense connected telemetry to a visible dashboard; Tango used replay and feedback. These support an inspectable technical workflow, not a causal win claim.
fresh_concepts.scope_cut: No production ingestion, arbitrary schemas, anomaly ML, compression promises or exactly-once delivery claim. A stable (event_time, event_id) key handles only unchanged duplicates with unchanged timestamps; account for every partition dimension.
fresh_concepts.risk: Tiger account access and correct refresh semantics are the first gates. Real-time aggregation does not automatically repair old buckets outside its refresh policy. One teammate must be comfortable with SQL.
fresh_concepts.secondary: DigitalOcean can host the actual API/UI; a qualifying GoDaddy domain can support the demo. Entry and simultaneous-award permission are unverified, so neither is claimed eligible.
fresh_concepts.go_no_go: By hour 2, connect to the accepted Tiger service and create/query one continuous aggregate; by hour 4, repair one deliberately late bucket and match the independent oracle. If either fails, switch to a finalist whose service works.

fresh_concepts.name: Handoff Lab
fresh_concepts.tagline: Practice a support call and repair the exact missing facts in the resulting ticket.
fresh_concepts.problem: A novice helpdesk volunteer can sound fluent yet omit the device, location or attempted checks needed for a useful handoff.
fresh_concepts.integration: ElevenLabs provides the live caller voice and conversational interaction. The app owns a hidden case fact card, five ticket fields, evidence links and retry state. The human is the trainee. Avoid a second model/provider unless it performs a demonstrably separate necessary task.
fresh_concepts.mvp: Three fictional support scenarios, a live spoken session, editable ticket, transcript evidence and retry of one missed question. The caller can reveal only authored case facts; uncertain transcript extraction needs review.
fresh_concepts.demo: Let a judge conduct a short call but miss the location. Show the ticket gap against the case card, retry the relevant moment, and show the corrected handoff. Display captions and a clear live-versus-recorded status.
fresh_concepts.validation: Fifteen scripted turns including interruptions and ambiguous answers; compare five ticket fields against human-authored truth. Report field precision/recall, unsupported facts, tool-state consistency and median/p95 turn latency. Five volunteers provide exploratory usability feedback, not efficacy proof.
fresh_concepts.difference: Human trainee practice with an evidence-linked operational artifact and a targeted repair loop. Yoodli and VirtualSpeech already offer custom roleplay and feedback; ElevenLabs already tests agents. Roleplay or scoring alone is not the distinction.
fresh_concepts.history_reason: Speak Free practiced speaking; Tango connected practice and feedback; ARSL made learning interactive. The proposed voice workflow transfers those patterns without requiring VR.
fresh_concepts.scope_cut: One support domain and five fields; no emotion diagnosis, real customers, outbound calls, voice cloning, enterprise integration or broad training curriculum.
fresh_concepts.risk: Voice account/quota, venue microphone/noise and reliable fact grounding. A recording is an honest backup but does not establish a working live loop.
fresh_concepts.secondary: DigitalOcean hosting is technically compatible. GoDaddy is a conditional naming addition. Category-entry and award-stacking eligibility remain unverified.
fresh_concepts.go_no_go: By hour 2, one real conversation must update a visible field and preserve the case truth. If audio or quota fails, prefer LineCheck with working Gemini access rather than relabel a text-only app as the voice build.

fresh_concepts.name: EvidenceDelta
fresh_concepts.tagline: Show which source change altered an answer and when the evidence is insufficient.
fresh_concepts.problem: A student comparing two versions of a campus notice needs to know what changed in the requirements, not just receive a plausible summary.
fresh_concepts.integration: Use version-filtered Cortex Search retrieval plus actual Cortex REST inference. Stable document/chunk IDs and explicit version metadata separate the two evidence sets; use Snowflake as the sole data/AI stack.
fresh_concepts.mvp: Twenty authored or permission-compatible notices in two preloaded versions; one question, side-by-side cited answers, a changed-fact view and missing/conflicting-evidence state. A text-only corpus avoids OCR.
fresh_concepts.demo: Ask the same question against two versions where one deadline changed. Highlight its source passage, then show an unchanged case and a question neither version answers.
fresh_concepts.validation: Twenty labeled question/version pairs, including changed, unchanged, absent and contradictory facts; reserve a test subset. Count unsupported claims, missed changes and correct abstentions; validate returned source/version IDs.
fresh_concepts.difference: A bounded source-version comparison and evidence audit rather than a generic RAG chat page. Preload indexes so index-refresh timing cannot masquerade as a policy change.
fresh_concepts.history_reason: IntelliSchedule brought relevant information into a task; Pegasus made data queries inspectable; supplementary A11y Tools adapted web information to user needs.
fresh_concepts.scope_cut: No institution-wide crawling, auto-updating policies, legal interpretation or automatic eligibility decisions. One available model; no parallel Gemini stack.
fresh_concepts.risk: Snowflake account/role/model access, Cortex Search index readiness and retrieval variability. Confirm API acceptance and costs.
fresh_concepts.secondary: DigitalOcean may host the client/API; GoDaddy may supply a qualifying name. Both are technical possibilities, not verified secondary entries.
fresh_concepts.go_no_go: By hour 3, a Snowflake API call must return a cited answer from the correct version. If indexing is blocked, use a smaller explicit-text Cortex REST flow and restate the narrower scope.

fresh_concepts.name: ReceiptRelay
fresh_concepts.tagline: Record an equipment handoff that two independent organizations can verify.
fresh_concepts.problem: Two independent organizations may need a shared custody record without accepting either party as the sole database administrator. If they already trust one operator, a conventional database is preferable.
fresh_concepts.integration: A Solana program validates asset ID, expected version, current custodian and both authorized signers. One accepted transfer advances state; a conflicting transfer fails. Use a test network only if the challenge permits it.
fresh_concepts.mvp: One fictional asset, two wallets, propose/accept handoff, explorer-linked receipt and a deliberate conflicting-transfer attempt. No token economy or real funds.
fresh_concepts.demo: Co-sign a handoff; show the record; attempt a second transfer from the prior state and show rejection. Explain that the record does not prove physical possession.
fresh_concepts.validation: Ten valid and invalid state transitions covering missing signatures, wrong custodian, stale version, duplicate request and expired transaction. Verify both UI and on-chain state agree.
fresh_concepts.difference: An explicit no-shared-administrator workflow, not blockchain added to ordinary campus inventory. Its value depends on validating that trust assumption.
fresh_concepts.history_reason: Rent-A-Plug connected a ledger event to a concrete action; Pocket Park connected a resource to a transaction. Historical blockchain use does not establish a present need.
fresh_concepts.scope_cut: No real asset transfers, payments, speculative tokens, identity verification or universal custody platform.
fresh_concepts.risk: Unconfirmed trust need, no known Solana specialist, signing/expiry logic and unverified Devnet eligibility. These are selection gates, not minor stretch features.
fresh_concepts.secondary: DigitalOcean can host the interface, but multiple-category eligibility is unverified. Do not add Atlas as a competing custody authority.
fresh_concepts.go_no_go: Hold unless the trust need, test-network eligibility and a Solana-capable teammate are confirmed. If not, choose PantryRelay using Atlas.

sensitivity: A one-point rating change moves the total by 2–4 points; close scores are not meaningful precision. LostLink and BranchBridge tie at 79.
Without a SQL-capable teammate, lower ReplayBench feasibility 4→2 and dependency safety 4→2: score 79; Handoff Lab becomes preferred if its voice gate passes.
With no live voice access, hold Handoff Lab. With working Gemini and document skills, LineCheck is the practical fallback.
For 18 hours or less, choose the first scoped finalist with a proven account and core interaction; do not begin a multi-service integration from scratch merely to preserve the original ranking.
